m: अप-नाभि mfn. ‘without a navel’, without a focal centre (as the Vedi), TS.
अप-नाम m. curve, flexion, Śulb.
a curve, Śulbas.
अप-नामन् n. a bad name, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 187
अप-नामन् mfn. having a bad name, ib.
a: अपनामन् — Having a bad name. --n. --(म) A bad name.

m: अप-√ नी to lead away or off; to rob, steal, take or drag away; to remove, frighten away; to put off or away (as garments, ornaments, or fetters); to extract, take from; to deny Comm. on Mn. viii, 53, 59; to except, exclude from a rule Comm. on RPrāt. : Desid. -निनीषति, to wish to remove Comm. on Mn. i, 27.
a: अपनी — {c1c} P. 1 To lead or carry away, carry or lead off; cause to retire; तमप्यपनयेत् Ms. 3. 242. --2 (a) To remove (in all senses), destroy, take away; आर्तानां भयमपनेनुमात्तधन्वा Ś. 6. 26; शत्रूनपनेष्यामि Bk. 16. 30; so तृप्णां, भयं, भ्रमं, दोषं, संशयं, &c. (b) To rob, steal, take away, carry away or off; रक्षसा भीरु यतोऽपनीता R. 13. 24. --3 To extract, take or draw out from (dart, oil &c.); अपनीताशेषशल्यं Dk. 31; दिष्ट्या शल्यं मे हृदयादपनीतमिव V. 5. --4 To put off or away, take or pull off (dress, ornaments, fetters &c.); अपनीताशेषराजचिह्ना K. 206; एषां बंधनान्यपनय H. 1; चरणान्निगडमपनय Mk. 6; अपनयंतु भवत्यो मृगयावेषं Ś. 2; R. 4. 64. --5 To deny; नैतन्मया निर्दिष्टमित्यपनयति Kull. on Ms. 8. 53. --6 To except, exclude from a rule.

v: tri॰ apa + nI--kta । KaRqite, dUrIkfte, apasArite ca ।
m: अप-नीत mfn. led away from
taken away, removed
paid, discharged
contradictory, badly executed, spoiled
अप-नीत n. imprudent or bad behaviour.
a: अपनीत — p. p. 1 Taken away; removed, pulled off &c. --2 Removed from, deviating from, opposed to, contradictory; तत्त्वधर्मापनीतस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलं Rām. --3 Badly done or executed, spoiled; अपनीतं सुनीतेन योऽर्थं प्रत्यानिनीषते Mb. --4 Paid off, discharged. --तं Bad conduct.

m: अप-नीति f. taking away from (abl.), Nyāyam.

s: [Tin] puM, (na panTAH, naYsamAsaH, samAsAntaviDeranityatvAt atra ajaBAvaH .) apaTaM । ityamaraH ।

m: अ-पन्थ-दायिन् mfn. = अ-पथद्˚, Gobh.
अप-√ 2. नश् ‘to disappear’, Imper. -नश्य, be off, KauṣBr.
अप-√ नह् to bind back, AV.; (ind.p. -नह्य) to loosen, MBh. iii, 13309.
अप-√ नम् (with abl.) bend away from, give way to [NBD.], to bow down before [Gmn.], RV. vi, 17, 9.

v: tri॰ apagatA nAsikA yasya prA॰ ba॰ nasAdeSaSca । apagatanAsike । “asiM kOkzeyamudyamya cakArApanasaM muKamiti” BawwiH ।
m: अप-नस mfn. without a nose, L.
a: अपनस — a. Without a nose; असिं कौक्षेयमुद्यम्य चकारापनसं मुखं Bk.

m: अप-नत mfn. bent outwards, bulging out, ŚBr.; KauṣBr.

v: pu॰ apa + nI--ac । dUrIkaraRe sTAnAntaranayane ca । “apanayo vA'dfzwatvAditi” kAtyA॰ 25, 9, 2 । “tasya taRqulApanayo vacanAditi” kAtyA॰ 25, 44, 3 । “apanayaterdUrIkaraRArTatvAttaTAtvam ataeva “avinayamapanaya vizRo!” iti SaNkarAcAryyeRa dUrIkaraRArTatayA prayuktam । apakfzwo nayo vEparItye prA॰ sa॰ vA । ninditanItO duzwanItO ca । apakAre “tataH sapatnApanayasmaraRAnuSayasPureti” mAGaH ।
m: अप-नय m. leading away, taking away
bad policy, bad or wicked conduct.
a: अपनयः — 1 Taking away, removing; refuting (as an assertion); स्वमतात्प्रच्यावनमपनयो निग्रहः P. VIII. 2. 94 Com. --2 A bad policy or conduct. --3 Injury, offence (अपकार); ततः सपत्नापनयस्मरणानुशयस्फुरा Śi. 2. 14.

s: klI, (apa + nI + BAve lyuw .) KaRqanaM । dUrIkaraRaM । yaTA, -- “iti SrISAmbapurARe rogApanayane SrIsUryyavaktravinirgatastavarAjaH samAptaH” iti । (“nAtiSramApanayanAya yaTA SramAya rAjyaM svahastaDftadaRqamivAtapatraM” । iti SAkuntale .)
v: na॰ apa + nI--lyuw । dUrIkaraRe, KaRqane ca । apanIyate'nena apa + nI--karaRe lyuw । apakArasADane । apagataM nayanaM yasya । netrahIne tri॰ ।
m: अप-नयन n. taking away, withdrawing
destroying, healing
acquittance of a debt.
a: अपनयनं — 1 Taking away, removing, extracting &c.; गंडस्वेद˚ Me. 26; नातिश्रमापनयनाय Ś. 5. 6. --2 Healing, destroying, curing (disease &c.); रोगाच्चापनयने P. V. 4. 49. --3 Discharge or acquittance of a debt or obligation. --4 Subtraction, deduction.

m: अप-नयिन् mfn. behaving improperly or indiscreetly, Kathās.
अप-नेतृ m. a remover, taking away.
अप-नेय mfn. to be taken back, Nār.
अप-नि-√ धा to place aside, hide, conceal, TBr. &c.; to take off, AV.
अप-निधि mfn. treasureless, poor, MBh.
1. अप-निद्र mfn. sleepless.
bristling, erect (as the hair on the body), Naiṣ.
2. अप-नि-द्र mfn. (√ द्रा), opening (as a flower), Śiś.; Kir.
अप-नि-द्रत् mfn. id., Naiṣ.
अप-नि-√ ह्नु to deny, conceal, ChUp. &c.
अप-नि-√ ली Ā. (Imper. 3. pl. -लयन्ताम्) to hide one's self, disappear, RV. x, 84, 7; ŚBr.
अप-निनीषा f. the wish to expel, Dharmaś.
अप-निनी—˚षु mfn. wishing to expel (acc.), Kād.
अप-निर्वाण mfn. not yet extinct, Śak.
अप-निषादुक mfn. lying down apart, MaitrS.

v: tri॰ pata--kta ni॰ ba॰ ta॰ । apatite । “ASavo'pannagfhasyeti” yaju॰ 6, 24 । na pannaM patitaM gfhaM yasyeti” vedadozaH । pannaga ityatra hi pannaSabdasya patitArTakatvaM dfzwam ॥
a: अपन्न — a. Ved. Not going down, not fallen or sunk, indestructible.

m: अ-पन्न-द mfn. = अ-पन्न-दत्, q.v., Gaut.
अ-पन्न-दत् mf(अती)n. whose teeth have not fallen out, TS.; TBr.
अ-पन्न-गृह mfn. whose house has not fallen in VS. vi, 24.

v: pu॰ apa + nuda--BAve GaY । svaRqane, dUrIkaraRe, apasAraRe ca । “tasyApanodAya PalapravfttAviti” raGuH । “brahmahatyApanodAya mitaBuNniyatendriya” iti manuH ।
m: अप-नोद m. = अप-नुत्ति.
अप-नोदक mfn. removing, dispelling, Viṣṇ.

s: klI, (apa + nud + BAve lyuw .) KaRqanaM । dUrIkaraRaM । yaTA, -- “mAnApanodanavinodanate girISe” । iti SrIharzaH । (apanudati dUrIkaroti, apa + nud + karttari bAhulyAt lyuwi .) KaRqakaH । dUrIkArakaH । “yaTASvameDaH kruturAw sarvvapApApanodanaH । taTAGamarzaRaM japyaM sarvvapApApanodanaM” । iti manuH .)
v: na॰ apa + nuda--lyuw । apasAraRe KaRqane ca “enasA sTUlasUkzmARAM cikIrzannapanodanamiti” manuH । karttari lyu । dUrIkArake tri॰ । “yaTASvameDaH kraturAw sarvapApApanodanaH । taTA'GamarzaRaM japyaM sarvapApApanodanam” iti । “parAkonAma kfcCro'yaM sarvapApApanodana” iti ca manuH ।
m: अप-नोदन mfn. removing, driving away, Mn.
अप-नोदन n. removing, driving away, Kauś.; Mn.
अप-नोद्य mfn. to be removed.
अप-√ 3. नु to put aside, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अप-√ नुद् to remove, RV. &c.
a: अपनुद् — {c6c} P. To remove, take or drive away, destroy; नारीणामपनुनुदुर्न देहखेदान् Bk. 10. 13; न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्यात् यच्छोकं Bg. 2. 8 expiate, atone for (as sin).

v: tri॰ apa + nuda--ka । dUrIkArake, KaRqake, SoDake ca ।
m: अप-नुद mfn. (ifc. e.g. शोकापनुद, q.v.) removing driving away.
अप-नुनुत्सु mfn. desirous of removing, expiating (with acc.), Mn. xi, 101.

v: strI apa + nuda--ktin । svaRqane dUrIkaraRe । “parijanaSramApanuttyE” iti CA॰ upa॰ । “pApAnAmapanuttaye iti” “gurutalpApanuttaye” iti ca manuH ।
m: अप-नुत्ति f. removing, taking or sending away
expiation, Mn. & Yājñ.
a: अपनुत्तिः — f., नोदः --नोदनं Removing, taking away, removal, destroying, driving away; expiation, atonement (as of a sin); पापानामपनुत्तये Ms. 11. 210, 140, 93; Y. 3. 306; गुरुतल्प˚ Ms. 11. 107; ब्रह्महत्यापनोदाय 11. 76; कृच्छ्रोयं सर्वपापापनोदनः 11. 216, 253, 261.

m: अप-न्याय्य mfn. improper, KātyŚr., Sch.
अप-न्याय्य—त्व (n.)
